values: Motor Matchup overall ratios 1st 13.001, 2nd 7.21, 3rd 5.106, 4th 3.76, 6th 2.512 (final drive shown as '1')
conflicts.note: Kept Autoweb's US list with 1.48 third; Auto123 gives 1.47. Motor Matchup's 380 manual pages list what look like overall (gear x final drive) ratios with the final drive shown as '1'; dividing them by the gearbox ratios gives about 3.45 for 1st-3rd and about 2.76 for 6th, which supports a two-final-drive gearbox. That division is an observation, not a published final drive, and nothing published a lower-gear final drive. Read from search-result summary; page not opened. Second reader: Auto123's 380 manual pages re-read as 3.77, 2.09, 1.47, 1.09, 1.10, 0.91 (reverse 2.77), and Motor Matchup also shows a 4th-gear overall ratio of 3.76; third stays 1.48 (Autoweb) against 1.47 (Auto123).

values: Motor Matchup overall ratios 1st 13.001, 4th 3.76, 6th 2.512 (not gear x 2.76 for 1st and 4th)
conflicts.note: Second reader: kept Auto123's 2.76 because it is the only final-drive figure any source published, but it cannot be the final drive for every gear. With the listed gearbox ratios, 2.76 would give about 10.4 overall in 1st and about 3.0 in 4th, whereas Motor Matchup publishes 13.001 and 3.76; only 6th (2.512) agrees with 2.76. The gearbox therefore has a second, shorter final drive for the lower gears that no source stated. A simulation should take Motor Matchup's overall ratios for 1st-4th, or treat 2.76 as valid for 5th and 6th only; using 2.76 throughout would make the lower gears much too tall. Read from search-result summary; page not opened.
